notes.title: The Demo is now Available
notes.content:
The Tower Offender Demo is finally available.

It is only an early prototype of the game and is far from finished, but it should at least give players an idea of what they can expect. We plan to add many more levels and features in the coming months, but the basic idea behind the game is this.

Jump around. Plan your attack. Jump some more and make adjustments as required.

If you play the demo, consider joining our Guilded server:

https://www.guilded.gg/Lighthaus-Collective/groups/6DMYx8aD/channels/3c5a97bb-4b96-439b-b157-18c1214e9d7d/chat

We talk about the game and ongoing development and often have some spare keys for you to test the latest changes before anyone else.

Also tune in to our Game Dev streams on Twitch where we develop the game live on screen:

https://twitch.tv/yanni_boi

More updates coming in the New Year. We are excited and hope you are too!

notes.title: We have a Twitch Category!!
notes.content:
The wonderful people at IGDB have accepted Tower Offender into their catalogue and this can mean only one thing.... A new Twitch Category!!!

[b]Twitch Category[/b]

We honestly can't wait to see you guys play our game and get some much needed feedback, so to make that easier for us when the time comes, we wanted to be able to see when people are streaming the game. So here it is!

https://www.twitch.tv/directory/game/Tower%20Offender

[b]IGDB Page[/b]

You can also check out the IGDB page for more information about the game (but lets face it, its all here on Steam 🤷 )

https://www.igdb.com/games/tower-offender
